title: Finite locally free of degree d descends along etale coverings (Stacks 02VO)
statement: Let $h:Y\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $d\ge0$ an integer, and $(\varphi_i:T_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ a family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] whose images cover $T$, $T=\bigcup_i\varphi_i(T_i)$. If for every $i$ the base change $Y\times_TT_i\to T_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free], then $h$ is finite locally free of degree $d$.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02VO (lemma-descending-property-finite-locally-free), line 6225, with its proof (Morphisms 02KB and the fpqc descent of finite, flat, locally of finite presentation); an etale covering is an fpqc covering by Topologies, Lemma Tag 022C (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc)
